validated_incidents.title: Alleged UFO sighting near Salvador, Bahia - Negative Report
validated_incidents.summary: A report of a strange object descending in the Conde, Bahia region was investigated and determined to be fabricated, with no verified sightings by local residents or officials.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: Story of strange object descending in region of Conde Bahia apparently fabricated in Rio no such objects seen by anyone in the area according to newspaper reporters and others who rushed there before investigation reports were received Secretary Public Security speculated object might be weather balloon but no such sighting verified.
validated_incidents.resolution_notes: Report deemed fabricated with no actual sightings verified. Secretary of Public Security speculated it might be a weather balloon but no such sighting was verified.

validated_incidents.title: Swedish Air Force Pilot Sighting
validated_incidents.summary: A Swedish Air Force pilot observed a dark, cigar-shaped object approximately 50 feet long flying at an estimated 400 m.p.h. over central Sweden in August 1946.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: On 14 August, at 1000 hours, he was flying at 650 feet over central Sweden when he saw a dark, cigar-shaped object about 50 feet long and 3 feet in diameter flying 200 feet above and approximately 6,500 feet away from him at an estimated speed of 400 m. p. h.
validated_incidents.size_description: about 50 feet long and 3 feet in diameter
validated_incidents.resolution_notes: Report cast doubt due to aerodynamic impossibility of maintaining constant altitude without wings over hilly terrain

validated_incidents.title: Ghost Rockets over Scandinavia - General Campaign
validated_incidents.summary: Multiple reports of flying missiles described as either 'a ball of fire with a tail' or 'shiny cigar-shaped objects' were reported over Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and Norway from late May through October 1946, with nearly 1,000 reports received by Swedish authorities.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: Flying missiles were first reported over southern Sweden in late May 1946 by the press, which gave the missiles the name of "Ghost Rockets." In June, the missiles also had been reported over Finland and Denmark. By July, the number of sightings over Sweden had greatly increased, and several also had been reported over Norway.
validated_incidents.shape_description: ball of fire with a tail or shiny cigar-shaped object
validated_incidents.resolution_notes: Likely V-1 type missiles, possibly 2-10 real incidents; high-altitude reports identified as meteors or fireworks

validated_incidents.title: Lights observed during Boston to Dublin flight, October 2023
validated_incidents.summary: A pilot flying from Boston to Dublin observed white lights in the sky near Gander, Canada at 37,000 feet that appeared to be at or above 50,000 feet. The lights cycled from dim to bright over 10 seconds to one minute and resembled airplane landing lights but the pilot ruled out conventional explanations.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: - first observation of the lights occurred in October 2023. - was flying from Boston, MA to Dublin, Ireland where he saw the lights in the northeast towards Gander, Canada. - was at an elevation of 37,000 feet and believed the lights were higher than him, probably at 50,000 feet or higher. The lights were white in color, would start out as dim, and get brighter before they eventually faded out.

validated_incidents.title: Multiple light sightings during transatlantic flights, October 2023-February 2024
validated_incidents.summary: A pilot reported approximately ten sightings of white lights between October 2023 and February 2024 during flights, typically observed between midnight and 3 AM. The lights were observed in multiple directions including North Dakota, west coast, and mid-Atlantic coast, ranging in quantity from one to four at a time with varying movement patterns.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: Since spotting the lights the first time, - has seen them approximately ten times. At times the lights would disappear for minutes before returning. - has seen the lights for 45 minutes up to two hours. - has seen the lights in all directions except for towards the south.
validated_incidents.location_text: North Dakota, west coast, mid-Atlantic coast

validated_incidents.title: Black triangular UAP over Colorado Springs, October 2023
validated_incidents.summary: A witness observed a dark-gray cloud in the sky near Colorado Springs that dissipated as a large black triangular object with red lights at each corner emerged, initially moving at helicopter speed before accelerating to possibly Mach 1-2, performing unusual banking maneuvers before disappearing.
validated_incidents.raw_excerpt: As he watched the cloud, he saw a constant, diffuse red light on the bottom front point of a solid black triangular shaped object coming out of the cloud towards the south, southeast. The object behind the point became wider and larger as it exited the cloud until - saw the entire equilateral triangular object with a red light in each of the three corners.
validated_incidents.reporting_unit: Supervisory Special Agent and Task Force
validated_incidents.size_description: very large, could have been as large as the parking lot, estimated 3-5 stories in thickness
validated_incidents.resolution_notes: Object exhibited anomalous flight characteristics including instantaneous acceleration and banking motion opposite of conventional aircraft; witness reported electronic interference on phone call after event
